mainText: Spain test will reveal if Tuchel and England have learned World Cup lessons. England's game with world champions Spain will reveal if head coach Thomas Tuchel has learned from summer disappointment, says chief football writer Phil McNulty. Respect? Exposure? Why England's star names are going abroad. Harry Kane, Jude Bellingham and Anthony Gordon are three of England's current biggest stars, but all have chosen to play their club football abroad. Who am I? Plus today's other quizzes. Test your football knowledge against today's Who Am I?, Five in Five and Brainteaser.

titleText: Other news you might find interesting
mainText: Staggered age of consent to be discussed after Brand allegations, minister says. A woman who alleges she was raped by the jailed comedian when she was 16 is campaigning to see relationships between 16-and 17-year-olds and adults made illegal. Ex-Met Police inspector lied about wife's death in Barbados hotel room, BBC learns. Warren Arter faced claims of sexually exploiting crime victims - his wife was found in a blood-stained room. Minister backs legal right to job support for young people. The work and pensions secretary said the level of support currently on offer was too vague. Man and woman die and four arrested after police pursuit crash in Leeds. Four people have been arrested on suspicion of causing death by dangerous driving, police say.
